title: Mega Trek V10.0
shortDescription: Pack your bags and be ready to have fun with the views of Kootagallu Hills
detailedDescription:
Pause the assignments and pack your bags: MegaTrek V10.0 is here to rescue your Sunday! 🥳

Join the Rotaract Club of BMSCE and Rotaract Club of Banashankari as we swap textbooks for the breathtaking views of Kootagallu Hills 💫

✨ Trek for a noble cause (Asia Book of Records legacy!)
✨ Meet new people & make unforgettable memories
✨ A guaranteed mental reset before Monday hits

📅 29th November 2026 (Sunday)
💸 Slab 1: ₹849 (Ends Nov 14th! ⏳)

Drop the pen, pick up the pace.
